customers_lifecycle_check.name: customers_lifecycle_check
customers_lifecycle_check.value:
("customers"."status" = 'active' and "customers"."owner_id" is not null)
        or ("customers"."status" in ('public','invalid') and "customers"."owner_id" is null)

follow_up_actions_lifecycle_check.name: follow_up_actions_lifecycle_check
follow_up_actions_lifecycle_check.value:
("follow_up_actions"."status" = 'pending' and "follow_up_actions"."completed_at" is null and "follow_up_actions"."cancel_reason" is null)
        or ("follow_up_actions"."status" = 'completed' and "follow_up_actions"."completed_at" is not null and "follow_up_actions"."cancel_reason" is null)
        or ("follow_up_actions"."status" = 'cancelled' and "follow_up_actions"."completed_at" is null and length(trim("follow_up_actions"."cancel_reason")) > 0)

follow_up_actions_target_check.name: follow_up_actions_target_check
follow_up_actions_target_check.value:
"follow_up_actions"."customer_id" is not null and (
        ("follow_up_actions"."plan_kind" = 'customer_visit' and "follow_up_actions"."opportunity_id" is null and "follow_up_actions"."complaint_id" is null)
        or ("follow_up_actions"."plan_kind" = 'opportunity_follow_up' and "follow_up_actions"."opportunity_id" is not null and "follow_up_actions"."complaint_id" is null)
        or ("follow_up_actions"."plan_kind" = 'complaint_follow_up' and "follow_up_actions"."complaint_id" is not null and "follow_up_actions"."opportunity_id" is null)
      )

follow_up_actions_complaint_target_check.name: follow_up_actions_complaint_target_check
follow_up_actions_complaint_target_check.value: "follow_up_actions"."complaint_id" is null or "follow_up_actions"."customer_id" is not null
